name: app-rail
title: App rail
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A narrow rail of destinations, workspaces, and the current person. Active item is marked. No theme of its own.

meta.descriptionEs: Riel estrecho con destinos, espacios y la persona. El activo queda marcado. No trae tema.

examples.title: Riel de la app
examples.description: Riel estrecho con destinos, espacios y la persona. El activo queda marcado. No trae tema.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Vacío, textos largos, RTL y cantidad.

meta.usage: <AppRail label="Espacios" mark="Á" items={[{ id: "chat", label: "Mensajes", active: true }]} />

api.name: workspaces / user
api.description: Marks at the bottom. The host owns the names.

api.name: onSelect
api.description: Chooses a destination. It does not navigate by itself.

api.name: status
api.description: Loading pulse, empty copy, or an alert.
